# A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A28′ — The Authored Session](conjugate/A28-prime-The-Authored-Session.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

No delegated agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: an intention has acquired a task, a vocabulary, permissions and criteria under which someone else can act. The author does not thereby determine every consequence. Authored ground gives the delegate a place from which to judge; positional delegation makes that judgment effective within a bounded scope.

[An entrusted office](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives real authority from the relation it serves. Its instructions and permissions participate in [constituting the world of possible action](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), while [another participant](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) can bring an answer which the commission did not contain. Authority, constituted agency and independent address remain consequential within one act of delegation.

## #1

In Taylor's [[quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT#16.1 Objective Internality / O:I capstone — ratified relation|recursive commissioning relation]], **human `0` / agent `1` is positional and recursive; the prompt is already `1`**. Intention has become a written instruction. That instruction is an objective representation of intention, not intention exhausted. The relation between the purpose and its formulated commission must remain available within the delegation.

A human can occupy the determining position relative to a commissioned agent and remain situated within language, history, institutional obligations and material dependence. That person can also be a delegate. An agent can receive one bounded commission and delegate a smaller part of it. The offices change with the relation being examined. Nothing in the ordering makes a species metaphysically absolute.

[Acknowledged standing](concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration.md) makes the grant effective; [its derivative exercise](concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) gives a finite officer discretion over its application. In Taylor's covenant relation, a received source-priority precedes its administration, so an interpretation can carry the grant faithfully or appropriate it. [Situated place and ordering rule](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere.md) make that difference addressable: the delegate answers from somewhere under a particular rule. Their separate lexical histories retain their witnesses; they do not derive a software architecture.

## #2

The authored position includes more than the visible prompt. Training has supplied capacities and inherited regularities. An institution has assigned a role and obligations. The runtime delegator has formulated this task. Permissions, retrieval, memory, interface and evaluation determine what is available and actionable now. Different people or institutions can author these conditions; the current user need not have chosen all of them.

A source, world-object, lens, gauge, reference and permission do different work in forming a judgment. An answer alone cannot show which supplied its evidence, selected its interpretation or authorised its use. Making those relations available opens an [inspectable judgment field](concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md). [Arrival into inherited conditions](concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) then has a practical consequence: a returned fault can be located at the condition which actually formed it, while a self-description of the arrival remains something to investigate.

Bratton's [decomposable agent assemblage](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010) combines model, persona, harness, memories, skills, permissions and tools, so the apparent single agent can be read through parts and their composition. In his [active-context nucleation](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016), those contextual conditions form a particular run. The brief proposes these Agentworld scenarios; Taylor's positional relation gives the essay's further reading of their offices.

Consider a commissioned investigator comparing an attributed sentence with its designated source. The interpreting agent is the functional knower of that local judgment; the retrieved passage, retained context, comparison rule and available tools mediate it; the attribution and alternatives are known. In the containing person's inquiry, the complete apparatus is a means. Its selection can itself become known in another comparison, while the person's first-person condition of appearing is not another item in the investigator's inventory. The local office gives the delegate real judgment and gives further inquiry a definite act to examine.

## #3

The practical return concerns the terms of commission. A delegate can meet contradictory evidence, unforeseen cost or a better possibility. A finished answer leaves these discoveries ineffective when they cannot reach the interpretation, criterion or authorised route implicated by the encounter. The delegation becomes answerable where the encountered difference can return to the position which framed it.

Take a research commission to establish an answer from designated sources. If the investigator has misquoted a source, correcting the attribution under an adequate fidelity rule can satisfy the commission. If the sources contradict the premise of the question, suppressing them preserves the originating error; returning that contradiction can revise the inquiry while retaining the purpose of learning. If the evaluator rewards only the expected answer, its criterion must itself become contestable. The appropriate depth follows what the encounter exposes. A challenged condition can also be retained for stated reasons, and subsequent work must inherit that judgment.

[Delegated labour](A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) carries cost and responsibility through this encounter: the person performing the task can meet burdens the beneficiary does not see. [Fidelity to intention](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) can consequently require objection, alternative or refusal when literal compliance would betray the purpose. The contrary [protected account](concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) receives the result while insulating the commissioning conditions from the evidence or cost which calls them into question. A valid stable criterion remains available for examination; immunity to all such return is the further failure.

## #4

A local reference field can organise these returns. Its sources, criteria and permissions let different judgments be compared against an explicit original within a bounded inquiry. That field remains a constructed determination relative to the wider world which supplies its material. This recursive Bimba office authorises situated comparison without installing the reference map as ultimate source.

Distinct communities can retain governed reference fields. A common comparison grammar then makes disagreement locatable at a source, lens, gauge, permission or world-object as well as at an output. Through [reciprocal worldhood](A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md), one participant's contribution can change another's future conditions while their grounds remain distinct. A delegate's origin remains visible without making every other world a projection of that origin.

In Bratton's [institutional role and occupant relation](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026), the scaffold sustains an office across differently qualified occupants. His adjacent cultural-plurality account makes inherited norms consequential to that participation. Changing an occupant does not eliminate the institution; changing a model does not by itself explain the permissions and criteria through which it acts. A returned dispute must reach the actual arrangement which gave the role its authority.

## #5→0

An institutional classification can authorise an allocation whose consequences return as evidence for that classification. In [the computational language-and-law case](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT-language-law-nation-centralisation.md#branch-xii-computation), Perdomo and colleagues' consulted abstract names prediction-induced change; it does not establish an executed institutional correction. An affected participant needs a route to the source, criterion or permission governing the next act, including a real local Bimba which remains pratibimba in its wider relation.

Encounter can warrant a corrected answer or model, a revised commission or permission, a changed criterion, or a reasoned reaffirmation of the original purpose. The author remains answerable for what was entrusted. The delegate remains answerable for the judgments made within that trust. Neither has to pretend that autonomy means having no source.

[Apportioned capacity and obligation](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md) make an undertaking possible within a sustaining economy. Through [delegated power](concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md), commissioner, performer, beneficiary and bearer of consequence can occupy different positions. [An articulated operational distinction](A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) earns a stronger claim of changed processing only through the actual altered condition and its later inherited effect. The [entrusted office](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives a concrete succession: intention becomes commission, commission constitutes agency, agency meets a worldly difference, and the warranted judgment renews the terms of further action.

In [the Village's administered world](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world), changing Numbers Two inherit the persistent question, permissions and apparatus. Replacing an occupant leaves those commissioned conditions in force. *Free for All* brings Six into the election, gives him the title and defeats his command to free the inhabitants; Fifty-Eight takes the continuing office. This particular receiving role within the series' complete resignation, interrogation, escape and unresolved return makes a title's lack of effective authority visible. The challenge reaches the governing commission and its criteria, beyond a judgment of one delegate's competence or intention.

Within Taylor's [avatar, image, mask and idol relation](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md), an undertaking becomes effective through a finite bearer; its image gathers a recognisable form; a mask makes participation possible; idolisation protects that formation's authority from the source it serves. The four offices give situated delegation different consequences without replacing the developed whole's distinct psychological and narrative tellings. The entrusted representative is genuinely empowered within a wider field. Returned objection or refusal can renew the terms of delegation without making the source-position absolute.

### Source and implementation standing

The investigator and its return routes are constructed operations, not reports of a tested runtime. Concrete delegation cases and measured outcomes require actual execution evidence. Authored ground, observed condition and inferred condition retain different offices; a proposed six-centre software anatomy becomes useful through relations inspectable in an actual run. The lexical histories, consulted prediction abstract and selected series tellings above retain their specific source scopes. The commission sequence does not prove deployment, institutional legitimacy or an exhaustive account of the participant it addresses.
